summary.tldr: Requires the finance minister to develop a national framework for a guaranteed livable basic income for people over 17 in Canada and report to Parliament.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Finance to develop a national framework for a guaranteed livable basic income program for people over 17 in Canada, including temporary workers, permanent residents and refugee claimants.
Requires consultation with health, employment, social development and disability ministers, provincial officials, Indigenous elders, Indigenous governing bodies, and other stakeholders and experts.
Sets rules for the framework, including how to define a livable income by region, national standards for health and social supports, and no education, training or work requirement for eligibility.
Requires the framework to protect health and disability services and benefits from being reduced because of the program.
Requires a report within one year, publication on the Finance Department website, and yearly review reports after that.
